title: A non-holder's observation note is told to claim the item before execution
outcome: A non-holder's observation note is told to claim the item before execution
acceptance: A holder's own note and a bare show of an unclaimed item keep their existing claim guidance
Tests cover the observation receipt over the CLI and MCP

The receipt of a non-holder observation note on an unclaimed item does not lead with claim or say 'claim it before execution'; it says the note was recorded as an observation with no execution credit, and its next commands fit an observer
